replies.body:
Hello. 

We are currently reviewing your evidence, as there is a part that we are not sure about, that it was indeed him. Due to the fact that he is shifting while flying I'm unable to see his tag. Now I'm slightly curious, how did you immediately recognize it was him? 

Looking forward to your response, and thanks for helping to keep the network clean. 

Regards, 
Javi
